children.value: > Fact From Story: Epstein had quietly set up a trust in the Virgin Islands as a repository of his personal fortune, valued at $577 million at the time of his death.
> Fact From Story: When Epstein was found dead a few months later in his cramped Manhattan jail cell, George saw an opening.
> > Fact From Story: George decided to go after the estate and those who might have helped Epstein.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: An attorney general can investigate and pursue legal action against an estate if they believe there has been wrongdoing.
> Commonsense Knowledge: When someone dies, their estate is responsible for their debts and legal obligations.
